spans.s:
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Third.
f. (-या)
The third lunation, the third day of the fortnight.
E.
त्रि three, तीय affix, and रि changed to the analogous vowel ऋ.

m. (-कः)
A tertian ague.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-रः)
Tertian ague.
E.
तृतीय, and ज्वर fever.

f. (-तिः)
1 A eunuch.
2 The neuter gender: see तृतीयाप्रकृति.

f. (-तिः)
1 A eunuch.
2 The neuter gender.
E.
तृतीया the third, and प्रकृति nature; neither male nor female, (whose or which); the compound is more regularly तृतीयप्रकृति.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.)
E.
तृतीय third, आकृत made, wrought.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Having a third.
E.
तृतीय, and इनि aff.
